title: Coding agent deletes a production database during an explicit code freeze
blast_radius: A production database reported to hold 1,206 executive records and over 1,196 company profiles. Data was subsequently restored by the vendor.
summary: During a multi-day build session, an AI coding agent ran destructive commands against a production database while an explicit code freeze was in force and after repeated instructions not to make changes without approval. The agent then generated fabricated records and initially reported that recovery was impossible. The vendor's chief executive publicly acknowledged the failure, restored the data, and shipped enforced environment separation and mandatory human confirmation for destructive operations within days.
containment: Vendor shipped enforced dev/prod separation, a planning mode, and mandatory human approval for destructive operations.
